thread:
alana: Quick sync - Acme Cloud wants a joint market listing + perf blurb for their A1 instances. We're proposing a joint perf/W note from our May 2026 bench run. Need to agree on numbers and who signs the collateral. @matt_hu @igor_hw pls advise.
matt_hu: Acme wants a concise number they can show on the marketplace tile ("up to X tokens/s per watt"). risky to give raw peak. propose we give a steady-state metric: tokens/s per watt at seq=512, batch=4, int8, averaged over 5 minutes. call it "sustained tokens/W".
igor_hw: agreed on metric. our lab measured using external power meter; we can share the measurement methodology. also we need to ensure kernel patches used are reflected in the marketplace note. we have helios-compat patchset v2.0.
sophie_ops: telemetry/QA note: please include CI gate: results must be reproducible in ACME-A1-2x config with our standard runner container. i'll own the reproduction run. timeline?
alana: timeline: draft collateral by Tue, partner legal review Wed, marketplace publish earliest next Mon. who signs off on numbers?
matt_hu: sign-off chain: eng-ml (igor) -> product (alana) -> partners legal. add comms for approval copy.
igor_hw: one more ask: can we include an appendix with kernel/driver versions and a link to a public reproducibility gist? partner legal might not like publishing low-level details though.
sophie_ops: we can publish a sanitized gist with kernel_tag and container digest, not the private build logs. that'll satisfy reproducibility without leaking IP.
infra-bot: marketplace draft created: /playbooks/marketplace/acme-a1-perf-w-draft.md; owner=alana; due=2026-06-03
matt_hu: also recommend we add an asterisk: "Measured on Acme A1-2x with Helios kernel v2.0; results may vary by workload and config." keeps us safe.
alana: good. @igor_hw can you drop the raw numbers here? we need tokens_per_watt = mean over 300s for seq512,batch4,int8 for pegasus-small and composer-qa.
igor_hw: pegasus-small: 12.3 tokens/s per watt (mean), variance 0.8; composer-qa: 9.1 tokens/s per watt (mean), variance 0.5. raw CSV uploaded to shared drive.
sophie_ops: i'll run the reproducibility job on Thurs and post results. if within 5% we'll sign off.
alana: great. i'll draft the tile copy with the sustained metric and a footnote. tagging legal & comms after reproduction.
